testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect an inactive project without activating it: tmp/obk-cancel-scenarios/features/application/project-dialog/project-dialog.feature:22:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect an inactive project without activating it ✔ Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Projects dialog lists an active project and another project ✔ And the active project is marked in the list ✔ When the user selects the other project with a single click ✔ Then the other project row is highlighted ✔ And the settings tree displays information for the selected project ✔ And the active-project mark remains beside the original project ✔ When the user chooses Done ✔ Then the Projects dialog closes ✔ And the chooser still displays the original active project
